title.zh: 将拉古纳省帕格桑詹镇帕格桑詹小学的名称变更为Francisco Benitez纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Name of Pagsanjan Elementary School in Pagsanjan, Province of Laguna, to Francisco Benitez Memorial School
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of Pagsanjan Elementary School in Pagsanjan, Province of Laguna, to Francisco Benitez Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Pagsanjan tại Tỉnh Laguna thành Trường Tưởng niệm Francisco Benitez
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Pagsanjan ในจังหวัด Laguna เป็นโรงเรียนอนุสรณ์ Francisco Benitez
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Pagsanjan di Provinsi Laguna menjadi Sekolah Memorial Francisco Benitez
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Pagsanjan di Wilayah Laguna kepada Sekolah Memorial Francisco Benitez

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_986_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In recognition of the educational contribution and eminent services rendered to the country by the late Francisco Benitez, the name of Pagsanjan Elementary School in Pagsanjan, Province of Laguna, is hereby changed to Francisco Benitez Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 2, 1954.
